chapter: Big bands, Depression work and the WPA band
title: Nine local big bands working at once
summary: Ernie names the many big bands working in New Orleans then, including Sidney Desvigne, Piron, Herbert Leary and Clark's Brown Buddies.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: See that time, 10, 12, 14 bands get a job sometimes two, three times a week.

Yeah, and matter of fact, we had about nine big bands around here at one time and all of them were working. Because Sidney Deadbeam band was on the captain, the president wasn't here then, and P-Ron was on the JS. See? And they had Herbert Larry's band around here. He was on the road with Desdune's big band. See? And they had Clark's Brown Buddies.
Is that a local band? That was a local band.

And then they had the Rapsodians. That's where the Sales brothers used to play with. Man, you say, his brother's... I can't see Man, he never got a band. The Sunnie South. His brother, then they had the Sunnie South band around here. That's where Edda Pearson was playing and Matt Leeson and a bunch. They was in that band. Yeah, my brother's band. And Bigfoot Bill, he had a... The piano band. No, the drummer. The drummer. Bigfoot Drummer, he had a band too. He had a big band around here. And they had the Crescent City High Hatters. And all of them were working. Evermore.
